description: Spring Boot config audit (application.properties / yml) — Offline security review of Spring Boot application.properties or application.yml (YAML flattened to dotted keys). Flags exposed actuators (exposure.include=*, heapdump, env, shutdown, jolokia, gateway, httptrace/httpexchanges, loggers), env/configprops show-values ALWAYS, public health details, Boot 1.x management.security off, H2 console (and web-allow-others), DevTools remote, debug/trace and DEBUG logging of security/web/SQL, stack traces in error responses, weak TLS protocols/ciphers, insecure session cookies, destructive ddl-auto, show-sql, database URLs with TLS disabled, root/sa database users, hardcoded passwords/secrets/API keys (values never echoed; ${ENV} references are fine), CORS *, and trusted forwarded headers. Considers a separate localhost management port. Returns verdict, score, grade, findings with keys, line numbers and fixes. Params: text= the file, or url= a raw file URL. Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_spring_boot_check
